intuition.title: The solvent comparison is a negative-control observation
intuition.text: Benzene and tetrahydrofuran are reported unable to dissolve selenium powder: no homogeneous solution forms and no PbSe is obtained under gamma irradiation. These are separate negative solvent observations, without individually specified doses or complete procedures.
intuition.source_locator: Supplied main PDF p. 2, solvent-comparison paragraph

intuition.title: Coordination and solvated-electron explanations remain proposed
intuition.text: The authors say the formation mechanism is unknown. They propose that ethylenediamine coordinates and stabilizes Pb(II), helps dissolve/complex selenium and increases its dispersion/reactivity. Solvated electrons formed under irradiation are proposed to activate reduction. No coordination structure, intermediate or kinetic measurement establishes this pathway.
intuition.source_locator: Supplied main PDF p. 1, final paragraph; p. 2, solvent and proposed mechanism

intuition.title: Keep source activity, absorbed dose and elapsed times distinct
intuition.text: The reported cobalt-60 activity is 2.59×10^15 Bq and dose is 3.0×10^4 Gy. Activity does not specify dose rate or irradiation duration. The several-hour precipitation interval occurs after irradiation; the numerical 4 h applies only to vacuum drying.
intuition.source_locator: Supplied main PDF p. 1, preparation paragraph and right-column continuation

intuition.title: One typical specimen joins XRD and TEM
intuition.text: The typical XRD sample is prepared from 0.05 kmol/m³ lead acetate in selenium-saturated ethylenediamine. The TEM text and caption explicitly identify the same sample. Cubic phase and 6.12 Å cell constant are XRD results; the 30 nm average is a TEM particle size, not a crystallite-size fit.
intuition.source_locator: Supplied main PDF p. 1, Figures 1–2 and their adjacent paragraphs

intuition.title: Ambient synthesis does not replace the explicit drying condition
intuition.text: The introduction describes room-temperature, ambient-pressure processing. The detailed workup explicitly ends in 4 h of vacuum drying at room temperature. Retain that specific vacuum condition rather than extending the generic pressure description into drying.
intuition.source_locator: Supplied main PDF p. 1, introduction and preparation continuation

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

general_background.title: Conversion of a nonmetal precursor
general_background.summary: Chalcogen and pnictogen precursors can differ in how they release or transfer the element during a reaction. Bonding, coordination and the reaction medium can influence the activation or transfer steps that make an element available for growth.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
